item.title: Reply to a Lunch Invitation
item.prompt_text: Your neighbour has invited you to lunch at noon on Sunday. You can come at half past twelve after work. Tell them how long you can stay, offer to bring fruit, and ask whether to go straight to the garden or wait by the front gate.
item.audience: a neighbour inviting you to a shared lunch
item.target_grammar: Can for availability, will for an arrival plan, and should for an indirect choice.
item.target_structure: Accept the invitation, explain your arrival, offer something to bring, and ask where to meet.

checklist.point: Thank the neighbour and give your arrival time.
Say how long you can stay.
Offer to bring fruit and ask about the meeting point.
